description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set" represents the proportion of data sources used in the training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart is divided into ten slices, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is attributed to SNLI, followed by a 15.4% slice for VITAMINC. XSUMHUL accounts for 13.0%, while MULTINLI and FEVER are represented by 11.3% and 16.1% respectively. SCITAIL and PUBHEALTH each make up 1.2% and 0.5% of the data sources. SCIFACT, ENTFA, and FACTCC each contribute 0.1%, 1.8%, and 2.6% respectively. ANLI is shown to make up 4.6% of the data sources, and MULTIFC is the smallest slice at 0.5%. The chart includes percentage labels for each slice, and the colors are distinguishable, with no legend present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
